prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1479; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Presenting complaints included right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion with forward elevation and abduction, and pain with overhead activity. Physical examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, positive impingement signs, and weakness on resisted external rotation. Imaging findings were consistent with a partial-thickness rotator cuff strain without evidence of fracture or dislocation.

Conservative management was initiated and consisted of a 25-visit course of physical therapy combining manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion exercises, scapular stabilization, and graded strengthening. Modalities including ice and ultrasound were used for symptom control during the early phase. Home exercise compliance was good throughout the course.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated substantial improvement in range of motion and strength, with pain now limited to occasional discomfort with heavy overhead lifting. Residual mild weakness persists but is functionally improving. Continued home exercise program and activity modification were recommended, with follow-up as needed.
